Title: Public preview: Azure Automation supports PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 runbooks

Body.Content:
Azure Automation now supports runbooks in latest Runtime versions - PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 in public preview. This enables creation and execution of runbooks for orchestration of management tasks. These new runtimes are currently supported only for Cloud jobs in five regions - West Central US, East US, South Africa North, North Europe, Australia Southeast. We are actively working on adding more regions to this list.

Azure Portal experience to author and execute runbooks remains the same as previously available Runtime versions. PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 can be easily selected through the dropdown menu during runbook creation.

Learn more about PowerShell 7.2 runbooks and modules.

Learn more about Python 3.10 runbooks and packages.

Try the new features and share your experience.

If you want this feature to be supported in regions of your choice, please reach out to askazureautomation@microsoft.com and share your regions.
